name: I.D. Choukyou Archives
source:
After the World War humans had to withdraw underground and build there colonies. Technology remains advanced, but there is no purpose in life, so birth rates drop down, and mankind is on the brink of extinction. Administrators encourage people to enjoy themselves and spend each day in happiness. But there are individuals who can't get used to such lifestyle. For them a retraining program is prepared. But what hides under retraining program name is...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
世界大战后，人类不得不撤出地下并在那里建立殖民地。科技依然先进，但生活没有目标，出生率下降，人类濒临灭绝。管理者鼓励人们尽情享受，幸福地度过每一天。但有些人无法适应这种生活方式。为他们准备了再培训计划。但再培训计划的名称背后隐藏的是……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
